thread:
Danielle: Quick check — are we on track for the SOC2 auditlog ingestion milestone? Need confirmation on KMS/HSM key rotation owner and PR status. Target: EOW.
Sanjay: I'm owning the HSM attestation doc; for rotation, Mike-Ops owns the Terraform PR. @Mike-Ops can you confirm? :eyes:
Mike-Ops: Yep — PR is open: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/312 — awaiting review from eng-infra. I still need to add rotation schedule and the runbook. Will add runbook today. @Clare-Security FYI.
Clare-Security: Thanks. I'll review the rotation schedule for compliance. We also need proof of key origin and the HSM attestation blob uploaded to evidence. @audit-bot please link the latest attestation.
audit-bot: Uploaded attestation_2026-03-12.tar.gz to s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026/attestations/ attestation_id=att-20260312-7f2
Sanjay: Heads up — runtime needs an endpoint to stream audit logs to the central collector. @Alex-ML any blockers on adding audit headers to gRPC path?
Alex-ML: Minor change — can add header metadata and a basic integration test. Will open PR by EOD. Need the collector stub: endpoint + schema. @Danielle can you confirm schema in the shared doc? https://docs.redwood/controls/audit-schema
Danielle: Confirmed. Collector accepts newline-delimited JSON (gzip optional). We'll version the schema. Please include an 'evidence_origin' field for attestation IDs.
Mike-Ops: PR 312 updated with rotation_schedule and runbook link. PTAL @eng-infra.
eng-infra-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered for branch feature/kms-rotation — build 458 passed, deploy to staging scheduled.
Clare-Security: Quick ask — for ISO evidence we also need the access-logs retention policy doc. @Priya-Legal can you confirm retention window?
Priya-Legal: For ISO we usually require 2 years retention for access logs, but confirm with legal/reg compliance on any regional variances. I'll post a short note in the doc.
Danielle: Action items: 1) @Mike-Ops finalize PR & runbook (due today) 2) @Alex-ML open audit header PR + tests (EOD) 3) @Clare-Security verify attestation blob & retention policy (tomorrow) 4) @Sanjay update owner record in depmap. I'll follow up on the status board. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: Updated depmap: https://depmap.redwood/projects/audit-ingest — owners: Sanjay (HSM attestation), Mike-Ops (KMS rotation), Alex-ML (runtime), Danielle (collector/product).
Danielle: Thanks all — if anything slips, ping this thread. I'll close when evidence capture is green.
